precision: torch CUDA FP16 autocast with GradScaler initialized at 1024
model: SMP 0.5.0 U-Net ResNet18, two inputs, single logit, TorchVision ImageNet1K V1 locally loaded and two-channel stem
optimizer: AdamW with gradient norm capped at 5.0 and epoch-wise cosine
loss: FP32 BCE plus per-example soft Dice smooth 1
crop_geometry: 512 letterbox, 30 percent per-side padding minimum 32; Pillow bilinear image/probabilities and nearest labels/box mask
prompt_assignment: top 40 regressed boxes at .10; best intersecting box per view by IoU >= .30 and full labeled target in padded crop; GT fallback; two maximum all-view-empty detector crop negatives
annotations: one fixed seeded draw of a complete annotator view per disk per epoch, plus known empty OOF prompts
endpoint: shared fresh364 detector; dev only preregistered 18 endpoint points; native largest component and min area150; canonical exclusive
comment: Source-aligned refiner, not exact ArtDoctor detector/ensemble. Replays nearest exact resized masks at source threshold hypotheses. No fit, threshold, or hardware tune from reserve.
